Actor.description: Who asked for the op: a person, an agent (model id) or a recipe.
Actor.title: Actor

edges.description: Explicit bin edges instead of quantiles.
edges.title: Edges

n_suggest.description: Propose this many new parameter points (maximin over a seeded LHS candidate set).
n_suggest.title: N Suggest

near.description: Near-duplicates by geometry invariants and point-cloud distance.
near.title: Near

n_probe.description: Seeded probe points for the distance test.
n_probe.title: N Probe

compare_parameters.description: Equal parameters make an exact duplicate; different parameters with the same geometry are a 'rerun' judgment.
compare_parameters.title: Compare Parameters

source.description: Path of the dataset to merge in.
source.title: Source

prefix.description: Prefix for incoming sample ids (default: source name + '/').
prefix.title: Prefix

key.description: parameters.<name> | geometry_params.<name> | forces.<name> | n_points | n_steps | id
key.title: Key

quality.description: Filter by recorded assertions on the current version.
quality.title: Quality

group_key.description: group: manifest `group` (trajectory id); geometry_hash: samples with identical geometry.
group_key.title: Group Key

write_card.description: Write CARD.md next to the manifest.
write_card.title: Write Card

op_prep_fields_cast_location.title: prep.fields.cast_location
op_prep_fields_cast_location.description: cell -> point: area-weighted average of incident faces; point -> cell: mean of the three vertices. The derived array records `derived_from` so trainers can pick the native one.

keep_source.description: Keep the native array next to the derived one.
keep_source.title: Keep Source

suffix.description: Name suffix of the derived array (default: same name at the other location).
suffix.title: Suffix

op_prep_fields_map.title: prep.fields.map
op_prep_fields_map.description: Proposes a canonical name for every field from the vocabulary (aliases, recorded units, channel count); names that are ambiguous (dynamic vs kinematic pressure) or below `min_confidence` come back as judgments and are only applied when `decisions` settles them.

decisions.description: source name -> canonical name for ambiguous or low-confidence proposals.
decisions.title: Decisions

set_units.description: Set the canonical unit where none is recorded.
set_units.title: Set Units

max_frac.description: Fail when a field has more non-finite values than this fraction.
max_frac.title: Max Frac

split.description: Statistics are fitted on this split only.
split.title: Split

max_steps.description: Transient samples: steps used per sample (evenly spaced).
max_steps.title: Max Steps

spatial.description: Also flag points whose value deviates from their mesh neighbours.
spatial.title: Spatial

max_points.description: Subsample above this for the spatial test.
max_points.title: Max Points

expected_scale.description: field -> expected magnitude (p99) in the recorded unit, e.g. {'stress_vm': 3e8} for steel in Pa; a ratio off by >= 100x raises a unit_plausibility warning with the implied factor (B3: card vs data).
expected_scale.title: Expected Scale

op_prep_fields_rename.title: prep.fields.rename
op_prep_fields_rename.description: Renames `fields/<old>` / `cell_fields/<old>` to the new name in every sample and updates meta.json and the manifest. Chunks are shared with the previous version.

missing.description: What to do when a sample lacks a source field.
missing.title: Missing

weight.description: Laplacian blend: x <- (1-w) x + w mean(neighbours).
weight.title: Weight

only_masked.description: Smooth only where static/<mask> is 1 (e.g. an outlier mask).
only_masked.title: Only Masked

justification.description: Why smoothing is legitimate here (recorded in provenance).
justification.title: Justification

max_area_change.description: Tolerance on relative area per level.
max_area_change.title: Max Area Change

max_area_change.description: Fail when the relative area changes more than this.
max_area_change.title: Max Area Change

method.description: signed_volume for closed shells; centroid: majority of normals away from the centroid (open shells).
method.title: Method

split_by_normals.description: Also split components where the dihedral angle exceeds `angle_deg` (patch-like parts).
split_by_normals.title: Split By Normals

min_faces.description: Merge parts smaller than this into their largest neighbour (0 = keep all).
min_faces.title: Min Faces

orient.description: Make face orientation consistent per component.
orient.title: Orient

fill_holes_max_edges.description: Fill boundary loops with at most this many edges (0 = off). Changes geometry; area delta recorded.
fill_holes_max_edges.title: Fill Holes Max Edges

name.description: Name of the static index array.
name.title: Name

op_prep_mesh_taubin.title: prep.mesh.taubin
op_prep_mesh_taubin.description: Preserves connectivity and field values. Optional boolean (N,3) point-field mask holds coordinate components after each lambda/mu pair. CPU is default; CUDA is opt-in. Smoothing changes geometry and does not recompute the simulation fields.

fixed_mask_field.description: Static boolean point field (N,3); True holds that coordinate component.
fixed_mask_field.title: Fixed Mask Field

from_unit.description: Length unit of the stored points, e.g. mm.
from_unit.title: From Unit

axes.description: Axis permutation with signs, e.g. ['x','z','-y'] for y-up -> z-up.
axes.title: Axes

vector_fields.description: Vector fields to rotate with the frame (default: every 3-component field).
vector_fields.title: Vector Fields

fail_on_open.description: Fail (not warn) when open edges exist.
fail_on_open.title: Fail On Open

op_prep_params_set.title: prep.params.set
op_prep_params_set.description: Writes `geometry_params[name]` of each sample's meta and lists the name in the manifest, so a model that conditions on it finds it.

values.description: parameter -> value, set on every sample
values.title: Values

mean_outlier_action.description: Severity of dataset-wide robust mean outliers. Use warn for measured sensor series with seasonal or operational shifts; finite-value, continuity and split checks remain blocking. The policy is recorded with each outlier assertion.
mean_outlier_action.title: Mean Outlier Action

frame_hashes.description: Hash the first frame of transient samples to find duplicated initial conditions.
frame_hashes.title: Frame Hashes

required.description: Checks that must have been recorded (closure checks first). Default: the checks that apply to the dataset: area_sum for surfaces, force_consistency and force_closure when samples carry forces, temporal_continuity for transient data, mesh_cells for steady meshes, and predictable_fields, nan_inf and split_leakage for every dataset.
required.title: Required

closure_required.description: At least one closure check (force/area/continuity/frame hash) must be present and not failing.
closure_required.title: Closure Required

max_fail_frac.description: Fraction of samples with failing checks tolerated (0 = none).
max_fail_frac.title: Max Fail Frac

approver.description: Record a human approval with the tag.
approver.title: Approver

op_prep_scalars_derive.title: prep.scalars.derive
op_prep_scalars_derive.description: Cd = 2 (∫ p n·d dA - ∫ τ·d dA) / (rho U² A_ref). Kinematic fields are multiplied by rho. The result goes to forces.json under `derived` next to the reported values, and the relative disagreement is an assertion (`force_closure`).

gauge.description: Subtract p_inf before integrating (needed on open surfaces).
gauge.title: Gauge

axes.description: wind: drag along the free stream and lift normal to it, the directions above turned by the angle of attack (meta.conditions.alpha, degrees, drag towards lift) and sideslip (beta, drag towards side); what a solver reports for a lifting body. body: the directions as given.
axes.title: Axes

compare_with.description: derived key -> forces.json key to compare against (closure check).
compare_with.title: Compare With

tolerance.description: Relative closure tolerance for the assertion.
tolerance.title: Tolerance

step.description: Transient surfaces: time step to integrate (default: last step).
step.title: Step

normals.description: Face-normal convention: OpenFOAM patches point out of the fluid (into the body), CAD/Luminary exports point outward; auto decides from the signed volume and records the choice.
normals.title: Normals

jump_z.description: Robust z of the log step change vs its neighbours.
jump_z.title: Jump Z

jump_ratio.description: Step change must also exceed this multiple of the neighbours' median.
jump_ratio.title: Jump Ratio

fail_ratio.description: Fail when a jump exceeds this multiple.
fail_ratio.title: Fail Ratio

write_signal.description: Store the relative step change as signals/continuity_<field>.
write_signal.title: Write Signal

adjacent_only.description: Only drop a frame identical to its predecessor (restart overlaps); False drops any repeat.
adjacent_only.title: Adjacent Only

max_steps.description: Keep at most this many (evenly spaced).
max_steps.title: Max Steps

target_dt.description: Keep steps closest to a uniform grid of this dt.
target_dt.title: Target Dt

field.description: Field whose spatial mean/RMS drives the burn-in test (default: first field).
field.title: Field

min_remaining.description: Never trim below this many steps.
min_remaining.title: Min Remaining

start.description: First step of the window (after burn-in).
start.title: Start

op_prep_units_convert.title: prep.units.convert
op_prep_units_convert.description: Each conversion is `field -> target unit`. The source unit is the field's recorded unit or `from_units[field]`. Optional `multiply_by[field]` factors (density, velocity, length) are checked dimensionally: source * factors must have the target's dimension. The declared unit, the factor and the method are recorded in meta.extra.fields.

conversions.description: field -> target unit (pint spelling: Pa, MPa, m/s, mm, ...)
conversions.title: Conversions

from_units.description: field -> source unit when meta has none or the card is wrong (recorded as `declared`).
from_units.title: From Units

multiply_by.description: field -> {reference: value} factors with units from `reference_units`, e.g. {'pressure': {'rho': 1.225}}.
multiply_by.title: Multiply By

rename.description: Rename after converting (e.g. kinematic -> dynamic form).
rename.title: Rename

geometry.description: Also scale points by this length unit conversion, e.g. 'm' when points are in mm (uses from_units['points']).
geometry.title: Geometry
